in_hebrew.name: תדריאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: תדריאל הוא שם שמורכב מ'תד' שפירושו שופט ו'ריאל' שפירושו האל הוא צדיק, או האל תומך. לפיכך, תדריאל יכול להתפרש כשופט צדיק של אלוהים או תומך צדיק של אלוהים. השם מופיע במסורות יהודיות ונוצריות כאחד, ומשמעותו הדגשת הצדק והתמיכה האלוהית.

in_greek.name: Θαδριήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Θαδριήλ είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές ρίζες, όπου 'Θαδ' σημαίνει κρίτη και 'ριήλ' σημαίνει Θεός ή ο Θεός είναι δίκαιος. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας και αντανακλά την πίστη στην παροχή της δικαιοσύνης και της προστασίας του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Thadriel
in_latin.long_meaning: Thadriel nomen derivatum ex hebraicis radicibus, ubi 'Thad' significat judicem et 'riel' significat Deum seu Deus est justus. Nomen hoc in traditione ecclesiastica usurpatum est et fidem reflectit in provisionem justitiae et protectionis Dei.

in_english.name: Thadriel
in_english.meaning: God gives a righteous judge or supporter
in_english.long_meaning: Thadriel is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, 'Thad' meaning judge and 'riel' suggesting God or God is righteous. The name signifies a belief in God's provision of justice and support. Historically, it reflects the Christian tradition of naming children to express faith and petition divine blessings. The name Thadriel conveys qualities of righteousness, justice, and divine support.

data.cultural_impact: The name Thadriel carries a rich cultural background, rooted in the Hebrew language and the ancient biblical traditions of the Christian faith. It is a powerful reminder of the deep connection between the people of God and their Almighty Creator.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Thadriel holds great spiritual significance as a reminder of God's omnipotence and sovereignty. The throne of God is the seat of divine power, and the thought of sitting on that throne can be both humbling and comforting.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Thadriel: God's mighty gift. Derived from Hebrew Theodor (God's gift) and Greek demios (mighty or divine). Embraces the strength and power bestowed by God, symbolizing a life dedicated to divine service.

historical_references.reference: In the medieval legend known as the 'Legend of the Holy Grail', a knight named Thaddeus (Thadriel in some versions) is a key figure. He is depicted as a knight of Galahad, one of the most noble and pure knights of the Round Table. Thaddeus's acts of chivalry and devotion to the quest for the Holy Grail are highlighted in the story.

Another reference to Thaddeus (Thadriel) can be found in some Christian apocryphal texts, specifically the 'Acts of Thaddeus' or 'The Acts of Addai and Thaddaeus'. This text is believed to have been written around the 1st or 2nd century AD and tells the story of the evangelistic mission of Thaddeus and his companion Addai in Edessa, present-day Turkey. They are said to have performed numerous miracles and converted many to Christianity.

platforms: The Wheel of Time Series by Robert Jordan
modern_usage.modern_context: Thadriel is a name of ancient origin, derived from the Hebrew language, meaning 'God is my right.' In modern contexts, this name is often found in various forms of media that draw inspiration from mythology and fantasy. Thadriel is a popular name for characters in tabletop role-playing games, such as Dungeons & Dragons, where players create unique personas for their adventures. In fantasy literature, Thadriel can be found in works like The Wheel of Time series by Robert Jordan, where it is the name of a significant character. Additionally, Thadriel is a popular name in the massively multiplayer online role-playing game World of Warcraft, where it is the name of a location and a character.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Thadriel, a minister in London, United Kingdom, shares that their name Thadriel meaning "Throne of God" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
